sources.entry: Beagle IM - Powerful XMPP client with support for file transfer, VoIP and end-to-end encryption.

summary.one_liner: BeagleIM is an XMPP chat client for macOS, built on the TigaseSwift library, with file transfer, VoIP and end-to-end encryption support.
summary.what_it_does: BeagleIM is a desktop XMPP (Jabber) client for macOS, based on the TigaseSwift XMPP library. The README says it supports file transfer, VoIP and end-to-end encryption. Users add an existing XMPP account or register a new one through the Preferences screen, then chat over XMPP. The README points to online Tigase documentation for more feature details and to GitHub issues for questions. It can be installed from the Mac App Store or through a Homebrew tap maintained by Tigase.
use_cases: chat over XMPP on a Mac
send files over an XMPP account
make voice or video calls over XMPP
register or add an XMPP account on macOS
install a Jabber client via Homebrew
notable: Built on the TigaseSwift XMPP library
Available on the Mac App Store and through a Homebrew tap
Supports file transfer, VoIP and end-to-end encryption according to the README
Account setup and registration happen in Preferences
caveats: The README does not describe platforms beyond macOS.
Some licensing options are available only on request, beyond GPLv3.
Support beyond free channels requires a paid Tigase support subscription.
